texts: On day 365 of Year 2, the second autumn equinox came.
The feather store held eight weeks of supply.
About ten sky-cats were visible on the cliff-spires in the morning.
The salt-bloom store held eleven weeks of winter supply.
The mire-essence store had not yet recovered from the losses of Year 1.

q1_issues.issue: (Patient sk_begin_1 (Year 2)) puts a structured calendar term in an entity role slot, but (Year n) is defined only as a Time-term value and role fillers must be lowercase entity symbols.

(Cardinality sk_group_1 (ParticleFromNormal 10 1)) violates the rule that Cardinality takes a native integer; the ParticleFromNormal distribution is licensed only in Measure-magnitude and clock-time slots.
(Inheritance salt_bloom bloom) decomposes a second level inside the noun modifier of salt_bloom_store, but the compound rule decomposes once and leaves a noun modifier in the symbol, un-exposed.
(Inheritance mire_essence essence) is the same unlicensed second-level decomposition of an un-exposed noun modifier.

'recovered from the losses' is a prepositional verb, so its object belongs in the preposition-named oblique (From sk_recover_1 sk_loss_1), not in the spatial Source role, which is reserved for PPs that answer 'whence'.

q2_gaps: approximated cardinal ('About ten sky-cats'): Cardinality is specified as a native integer and CardinalityPhrase covers only vague phrases with no number, so a hedged count has no licensed form
a calendar year as a clause participant ('Year 2 began on day 365'): (Year n) is defined only as a Time-term value, leaving a named year with no licensed entity symbol for a subject/role slot
a measure-of quantity phrase ('eight weeks of supply', 'eleven weeks of winter supply'): the 'measure' of-phrase is excluded from the genitive rule but never given an encoding of its own
review.notes: 'The second autumn equinox came' is parsed by the light-verb/event-noun route (tense and Time placed directly on the equinox witness); extending the 'occurred / happened / took place' rule to 'came' is plausible but not spelled out. The sigma of 1 on 'about ten' does follow the tight-hedge 10% convention, so the improvised Cardinality distribution is at least internally consistent.

issues.reason: Role fillers are lowercase entity terms and `(Year n)` is defined only as a structured Time-term value (UpperCamelCase term constructor), so `(Patient sk_begin_1 (Year 2))` is ill-typed — the same term is simultaneously used correctly as a Time value on line 5, which is exactly the type confusion.

Cardinality is stated to take `a native integer`, and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only as a Measure magnitude or an approximate clock value, so the distribution in the count slot is ill-typed and breaks the `Compute` hard-integer counting machinery the instruction set pairs with Cardinality.

The rule cited (`a noun modifier is never exposed`) bars `(Inheritance salt_bloom_store salt_bloom)`, which the parse does not emit; `(Inheritance salt_bloom bloom)` is the hyphenated transparent modifier+head genus the same section says to `always emit`, whether decomposition reaches a compound nested inside a compound is simply unstated, and the atom is true and well-typed.

Identical case to index 2 — `(Inheritance mire_essence essence)` is a compound genus, not the barred exposure of a noun modifier as the store compound's genus, and it is true and well-typed in gap territory.

The half that stands: `recover from` is a prepositional verb and its object does not answer `whence`, so the licensed head is the preposition-named `(From sk_recover_1 sk_loss_1)`; the half that does not: `Source` is the instruction set's own listed head for an event-side `from` oblique and the atom is true, well-typed and asserts nothing extra, so it is a head-choice error rather than false content.

gaps_confirmed: A hedged cardinal ("About ten sky-cats"): Cardinality requires a native integer and CardinalityPhrase covers only vague phrases carrying no number, so an approximated exact count has no licensed carrier.

A measure-of quantity phrase ("eight weeks of supply", "eleven weeks of winter supply"): the of-phrase rules explicitly exclude a measure ("a cup of water") from the genitive mapping but never give it an encoding.
new_gaps: The instruction set states no link between a named-year entity symbol (year_2, licensed by Names and casing) and the `(Year n)` Time term, so "Year 2 began on day 365" and `(Time e (Year 2))` cannot be related in the KB.

Whether compound decomposition reaches a compound MODIFIER nested inside a compound (salt_bloom inside salt_bloom_store, mire_essence inside mire_essence_store) is unstated — "decompose once, then stop" names a stopping condition only for parts already single.

`(Ordinal <entity> <n> <scale>)` specifies the scale as the associated event or an explicit -est dimension; a kind-ordinal over a non-eventive class ("the second autumn equinox") supplies neither, leaving the scale slot unlicensed.
adjudication.defect_summary: For index 0 the compliant form is a named entity for the year — `(Name year_2 "Year 2")` + `(Member year_2 year)` per Names and casing (the capitalized run exceeds the bare class word), with `year_2` filling the Patient slot and `(Year 2)` staying in Time slots only. For index 1 NO licensed form carries the content: Cardinality admits only a native integer and CardinalityPhrase only a numberless vague phrase, so the instruction-compliant behaviour under Core patterns ("carry it, or leave the whole claim out and record the gap") is to omit the count atom entirely and file the gap — which is why the hedged-cardinal gap above is the substantive finding here.
adjudication.notes: The reviewer's second gap is not a gap: Names and casing does license an entity symbol for "Year 2" (capitalized run exceeding the bare class word); the real gap is the missing bridge to the `(Year n)` term, filed above. The light-verb reading of "came" over the equinox event-noun (reviewer's note) is acceptable improvisation — every atom it yields is true and well-typed.
